label: Emergency Kit
title: Password365 Emergency Kit
keep: Keep this sheet somewhere safe (a physical safe, with your important documents). Together with your master password it is the only way to open your vault on a new device — there is no server and no account recovery.
step1: Install Password365 on the new device.
step2: If another of your devices still works: choose “{join}”. Otherwise choose “{restore}” and pick your backup file.
step3: Enter your master password, and this Secret Key when asked.
